## Activity

During August 2026, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 39 captures. This represents the activity submitted for review during the month. The reported total provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures set out below.

## Image quality

Of the 39 captures, 3 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 7.7. These images could not be used for grading, and the result is reported separately from the grading outcome. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

Grading identified 15 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1. This measure describes the central interval for the reported activity. Together, the capture total, image-quality result and grading outcome provide a concise operational summary for West Gate Eye Clinic for August 2026.
